problem_statement:
Implement a GPU/CUDA optimization for the kripke application.

The optimization should achieve the improvements described in the following commit message:

"now submitting breadth-first in streams.  A subdomain has its own assigned stream which it uses to synchronize H2D, Kernel and D2H - much simpler in Sweep_Solver. Also now submitting grids of 15 thread blocks - this reduces launch latency - for about a 20% perf improvement in the sweep kernel.  But now the number of SMs is a #define."

Focus on the following files:
- src/Kripke/Grid.cpp
- src/Kripke/Kernel/Kernel_3d_ZGD.cpp
- src/Kripke/Subdomain.h
- src/Kripke/Sweep_Solver.cpp
- src/Kripke/sweep_ZGD.cu

The optimization should maintain correctness while improving performance.
Keywords related to this optimization: optimize, efficient, performance, kernel, omp
commit_message: now submitting breadth-first in streams.  A subdomain has its own assigned stream which it uses to synchronize H2D, Kernel and D2H - much simpler in Sweep_Solver. Also now submitting grids of 15 thread blocks - this reduces launch latency - for about a 20% perf improvement in the sweep kernel.  But now the number of SMs is a #define.

problem_statement:
Implement a GPU/CUDA optimization for the kripke application.

The optimization should achieve the improvements described in the following commit message:

"Updated buildsystem for CUDA and CHAI.  ArchV_CUDA has properly been added.  Now in a position to start adding CUDA memory management and execution policies"

Focus on the following files:
- src/Kripke/Arch/LPlusTimes.h
- src/Kripke/Arch/LTimes.h
- src/Kripke/Arch/Population.h
- src/Kripke/Arch/Scattering.h
- src/Kripke/Arch/Source.h
- src/Kripke/Arch/SweepSubdomains.h
- src/Kripke/ArchLayout.h
- src/Kripke/Generate.cpp
- src/kripke.cpp

The optimization should maintain correctness while improving performance.
Keywords related to this optimization: kernel, omp, loop, mpi, memory
